Ouvre ta playlist sur Spotify, Deezer, A: Open your playlist on Spotify, Deezer, Apple Music, Tidal or YouTube Music and copy its share link. Paste it here, pick the destination platform and start the transfer: the track list appears, each track with its link on the new platform. You can copy the whole list in one click to keep it or send it.
Pas besoin de connecter ton compte : l'o: No need to connect your account: the tool reads the public playlist, with no access to your data. It's also handy to send a selection to someone who doesn't use the same app as you.
Faut-il un compte Spotify, Deezer ou App: Do I need a Spotify, Deezer or Apple Music account?
Non, ni chez nous ni sur les plateformes: No, neither with us nor on the platforms. The playlist just has to be public so its content can be read.
Pourquoi certains liens ouvrent une rech: Why do some links open a search?
Deezer et Apple Music reçoivent le lien: Deezer and Apple Music get the exact link of each track. On Spotify, Tidal and YouTube Music, the link opens a search for the title and artist: the right track comes first in almost every case.
Un titre manque à l'arrivée, pourquoi ?: A track is missing at the destination, why?
Un morceau peut ne pas exister sur la pl: A track may not exist on the destination platform, or be greyed out in the original playlist (unavailable in your country, removed by the artist). It is then left out.
Combien de fois faut-il taper ?: How many times should I tap?
Quatre à huit frappes suffisent pour un: Four to eight taps are enough for a steady tempo. The longer you tap, the more precise the value: each new tap refines the average.
Je trouve 70 alors que le morceau est à: I get 70 but the track is at 140, is that normal?
Oui : 70 et 140 BPM décrivent le même ba: Yes: 70 and 140 BPM describe the same beat, counted in quarter or eighth notes. Tap on the snare for the slow reading, on the hi-hats for the fast one.
À quoi sert le BPM une fois trouvé ?: What is the BPM useful for once found?
Les outils audio tournent dans ton navig: The audio tools run in your browser: your files are sent to no server, so you can drop in a track that isn't released yet. No account is needed, and there is no usage limit.
